macros.name: longest
macros.doc: Inside a song environment, the \longest{⟨song line⟩} command is used to declare the longest line of a song, that will be used to properly center the song stanzas, as allowed by the verse package.

macros.name: numbercouplets
macros.doc: Inside a song environment, the \numbercouplets command can be used to enable couplet numbering.
